# Distortion waves

Unmodified MIT source from Libraries.dev, pinned by commit and SHA-256 in provenance.json. The advertised npm package returned 404 on 18 November 2026. The upstream licence is included here.

Florrie lazy-loads WaveController for confirmed Content results. ContentReveal passes an empty decorative layer with capture, prewarm and live disabled. It never snapshots client details, captions or photos. The live result stays outside the controller's DOM and remains interactive. The wrapper destroys the controller after the short reveal, on privacy changes, reduced-motion changes, backgrounding and unmount.

No new runtime dependencies or package installation scripts are required. Update only against a reviewed upstream commit and regenerate the provenance hashes.
